ambient_events: Ammunition belts hang coiled from nails like sleeping snakes.
The buried container ticks and groans as it takes the day's heat.
A hand-lamp swings on its cord and throws the shadows around.
description: The bunker under the wastes nest — a half-buried shipping container sunk into the pasture and roofed with earth, close and hot and smelling of gun oil and dust. Belted ammunition hangs coiled from the walls; crates of scavenged spares and a bench of cannibalised parts fill the rest. Out here you fix the gun or you walk, so the gun gets fixed — dragged back to firing with spares and spite every time it's shot off its mount. A steel ladder climbs to the hatch and the open bed above.
name: Wastes Gun Nest — Bunker
